in_marathi.name: Kavi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Poet, Scholar, Wise One
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who knows and comprehends, a seer, a sage, a poet, a scholar, a learned one. Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kavī’ which means ‘shining, bright, or glorious.’
